overview:
Builderforce.ai is a large TypeScript/Node.js monorepo for an AI agent platform, with supporting Rust (desktop app via Tauri), Swift (macOS/iOS integrations), and Go (docs tooling) components.

**Core pieces:**
- **agent-runtime**: the core agent daemon/CLI with pluggable "extensions" (chat platform integrations like Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, iMessage, Matrix, etc.), channels, memory, voice-call, and "skills" (tool integrations: GitHub, Notion, Obsidian, Spotify, etc.)
- **api**: backend service (Cloudflare Workers via wrangler) with domain/application/infrastructure layered architecture, migrations, and QA sandbox variants
- **frontend / studio / desktop**: web UI, visual studio/IDE-like app, and native desktop app (Rust/Tauri) with crates for cloud sync, memory, vault, indexing
- **sdk / browser-sdk / feedback-sdk / brain-embedded / builderforce-embedded / studio-embedded**: embeddable client SDKs
- **packages/**: shared internal libraries (agent-loop, agent-tools, auth, caching, routing, TUI, canvas protocols)
- **docs-site**, **qa-e2e**, **worker**, **webdit**, **voice**, **clients/vscode**: documentation site, end-to-end tests, Cloudflare worker, document-conversion tooling, voice features, and VS Code extension.
